scope: Model-conditional response/current research, not noise ranking or production qualification
budget_unit: unique design vectors; each has three DC/AC training scenarios
hard_constraints: Frozen current/DC energy/positive rail/positive polarization and <=1dB response in every training scenario

OUTPUT_C.rationale: LF coupling into finite preamp/load; 1-4 parallel documented 47uF parts per leg bounded by count/energy/space research, not a changed acceptance budget
Same finite-load LF/energy/count bracket as conventional control; fixed servo/current retain mechanism and avoid per-unit trimming
Shared output feasibility bracket; stop on known macro integration failure before continuous search

FEEDBACK_C.rationale: Charge gain and feedback-reset LF pole around 100pF; excludes arbitrarily vanishing feedback, retains stability/noise gaps
Explore charge gain/LF reset pole from 100pF to 100nF while retaining fixed parallel 1Mohm base-current DC authority; no hand-selected transistor

OUTPUT_C.rationale: Preserve the same output budget; periodic protocol prerequisite holds ordinary DC-linearized optimization

staging: audit model/analysis prerequisites and rerun full baseline suite
cheap nominal DC then AC; stop family tuning after repeated baseline integration failure
bounded differential evolution for supported families only
full suite for continuous proposal plus withheld corners and independent seed
enumerate 1-4 actual parallel capacitor combinations including loss/leakage stress
full suite and independent seed for realized child; no value-equivalence acceptance

followup_policy.slot_unit: one explicitly limited DC/AC structural/discrete experiment or reserved prerequisite task; not arbitrary convergence extension
followup_policy.improve: Four preferred-output combinations per JFET niche; two full validation tasks
followup_policy.underexplored: One BJT structural child and four model/periodic prerequisite tasks held on absent evidence
followup_policy.new_concepts: Three retained catalogue handoffs reserved until model prerequisites exist
followup_policy.assumption_breaking: Two leakage/loss extremes applied to each combination; tests conventional ideal-passive assumption
followup_policy.rule: No family eliminated; unused held slots reported, never transferred to a favored family

source_resistance_ohm.rationale: Fixed gate divider and positive source current constrain no-trim bias; no source-current optimum claimed before joint JFE/noise/SOA validation

servo_slow_capacitance_f.rationale: 75kohm nominal divider Thevenin resistance implies 0.35-3.5s time constant; return ratio and servo/audio interaction missing so held

bootstrap_capacitance_f.rationale: Documented film anchors span tracking/LF isolation tradeoff; floating macro convergence and guard-loop stability prerequisite held

reset_resistance_ohm.rationale: Finite reset prevents DC saturation with pA input; ordinary series combinations require leakage/parasitic qualification; macro integration held

tail_resistance_ohm.rationale: Finite pair current/base-current authority versus gm/noise; missing bipolar 1f and joint process behavior prevents bias/noise optimization

carrier_frequency_hz.rationale: Above audio and within existing deterministic control bracket; physical oscillator/mixer/periodic-noise protocol missing
